name: Green Maw

facts.text: Level 65, 10,000 health, in the Cursed Forest. When it dies it splits into nine Parts of Green Maw in three sizes (levels about 58-60, 53-55 and 50).

story: Green Maw is a hunger the Cursed Forest grew in one of its pools, a mouth of green slime as big as a cart. It eats what falls in and what wanders by. The trouble with it is not killing it. The trouble is what happens after. A thing that is only a mouth does not die as other creatures do. It comes apart, into big pieces and small pieces and smaller ones, and every piece is still a mouth. The Ardee children call it the Maw that won't stay dead.
legend: Killing it is the first half. When it dies it splits into nine pieces of three sizes: AoE them down, biggest first, and keep the healers clear of the splash. Have mana left for the second half, because that is where most bands lose it.

aggro: The pool heaves and opens into a mouth.

phases.text: The Maw bulges and splits at the edges.

death: The Maw bursts into a dozen hungry pieces!

lairEntry: A green pool, very still, with teeth in it.

phases.text: Green Maw splits into hungry pieces!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Green Maw is dead, every last piece of it.

briefing: green maw splits into nine bits when it dies. [aoe ready|save mana for the pieces]

loremasterTopic.text: A mouth grown in a pool of the Cursed Forest. It does not die so much as come apart into smaller mouths.
